# Steamworks SDK

The `public/steam` headers and the win64 `steam_api64` redistributable from the Steamworks SDK (interfaces SteamClient023, SteamFriends018, SteamNetworkingSockets012), taken from the `steamworks-sys` 0.13.0 crate. `steam_api64.dll` is signed by Valve Corp. and matches the copy Steam installs with other games.

To update, download the SDK from https://partner.steamgames.com/downloads/list and copy its `sdk/public/steam` and `sdk/redistributable_bin/win64` over these folders. Use of the SDK is covered by the Steamworks SDK Access Agreement.
